about_the_game:
Hit the frontlines with a flexible kit of exclusive items that can respond to any challenge and any terrain.

Get the Season 1 Advanced Pack and receive:
  • “Brush Stalker” USG-90 Weapon Package
  • “Shadow Trace” NATO Recon Soldier Skin
  • “Bushfield” PowerPulse Defibrillator Skin
  • “Backup Plan” Weapon Charm
  • "Conspirator” Weapon Sticker
  • “Hot Extraction” Player Card Background
  • 1100 BFC
